thread:
Alex: Nautilus wants a phased cutover from CompetitorX. Wants minimal client changes, parity on prompts, token billing reconciliation, and an on-prem fallback. Can we list blockers?
Jess: Are they asking for identical HTTP surface or just drop-in behavior for their client libs? Sales said 'minimal changes' so likely surface-level compatibility.
Samir: POC engineering notes: main risks: tokenization mismatch -> content drift; session handshake (they use X-Session-Token header to maintain state); and different sampling defaults. Also need their eval set to measure parity.
Olga: For tokenization shim we can pre-tokenize and remap tokens that differ, plus normalize spaces and unicode NFC. Not perfect but often enough to hit parity targets.
Alex: Can Dedicated handle the sticky session header?
Samir: Yes — we can honor X-Client-Session and route to the same Dedicated pool instance via sticky routing. Need to validate session affinity under scale.
Meera (Legal): Customer requires no-training clause + 90d retention. Also wants HSM-backed keys and audit log export. Legal to draft addendum.
Olga: We support KMS integrations on Private; HSM keywrap patterns supported in Dedicated with a config change. I'll prepare integration notes and SOC2 excerpts.
deploy-bot: Presales deployment queued: nautilus-presales-shim v0.1 -> staging (job 4472).
Jess: Pricing question 1 — they want a delta vs CompetitorX if we run quantized model. Samir, rough $/1k tokens and latency hit?
Samir: Ballpark: for our quantized LLM on Dedicated, cost is ~0.6x CompetitorX per-token for 8k seq when batching is similar. Latency increase ~15% p50; p95 varies with concurrency (10-30%). I'll add a conservative cost table to the sheet.
Alex: Proposed POC acceptance criteria: 1) Top-1 intent parity >=95% on their eval set; 2) p95 latency within 25% of CompetitorX; 3) sample billing reconciliation report produced; 4) no-training and 90d retention enforced. Target: 2-week POC.
Samir: 2 weeks ok if they provide eval set + staging creds by Monday. I can run baseline CompetitorX calls for comparison.
Jess: I'll ask them for the eval set and creds today. Also confirm which endpoints they call most frequently so we can mimic load.
Olga: Uploading SOC2 excerpt and KMS notes to presales folder: https://redwood.internal/presales/nautilus/docs. Will also list required network allowlist IPs.
Meera (Legal): Drafted addendum for no-training and retention. Need Alex to review before sharing.
Alex: Reviewing now. Action items: Samir -> baseline runs + cost sheet; Jess -> collect eval set and creds; Olga -> security docs + IP allowlist; Meera -> addendum draft.
Jess: Quick smoke test command for customer to run against staging shim:
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood-inference.internal/v1/nautilus-shim/generate 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" 
  -H "X-Client-Session: 5802" 
  -d '{"prompt":"<their prompt>","max_tokens":256}'
```
Samir: Will run parity eval and post a short report by EOD Friday.
Alex: Thanks everyone. I'll sync with sales and ask Nautilus to confirm timeline. Marking thread presales-actioned.
